    elevator = []
    current_floor = 1

    for i in range(n):
        a, b = employees[i]

        current_floor = a
        # Add employee to the elevator
        elevator.append((a, b))

        while elevator and elevator[0][1] == current_floor:
            out_employee = elevator.pop(0)
            time += 1  # Time to get out
        # Sort the elevator queue to maintain the order
        elevator.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
        # Let people in the elevator
        while elevator and len(elevator) < 4:
            if elevator[0][1] > current_floor:
                time += 1  # Time to move up
                current_floor += 1
            elif elevator[0][1] < current_floor:
                time += 1  # Time to move down
                current_floor -= 1
        # Time to get in
        time += len(elevator)

    # Move the elevator to the last floor if not already there
    while elevator:
        time += abs(current_floor - elevator[0][1])
        current_floor = elevator[0][1]

            out_employee = elevator.pop(0)

            if elevator[0][1] != current_floor:
                time += 1  # Time to move up or down
            current_floor = elevator[0][1]

        time += len(elevator)
